requirement: Обычная проверка Core297 после смены адреса Dashboard сохраняет доверие, источник и точный вход установки.
patch_basis: Apply verify_route_projection_v99.patch to the original verifier, then apply the leaf join patch.

independent_delta_review: Source-only review confirmed the three exact applied request pointers and the isolated refusal controls on the tested source SHA.
scope: The isolated before view requires independently supplied predecessor and leaf pins, with the publisher marker produced by the exact builder function for the published view.
Only the initial derivation can run before the leaf exists. Before and after parity checked against the same private leaf bytes.
Exact native TLS ran with a disposable issuer. The genuine historical CA refused the disposable chain.
The stock inspect TLS gate ran in explicit and default shape. The check stops at composition.
not_executed: Full request, intent and commit through the ordinary actor and fresh default reader.
Actual TLS issuance, network forwarding, publication, installation and runtime acceptance.
next: Bind the existing prepared builder and publisher to the separately trusted handoff. Keep the V98 marker, applied beforeimage and V99 marker distinct. Consume the actual canonical intent and commit and use the unchanged stock TLS and native credential checks in a fresh inspect process.
